Species Included in Proposed Panamanian Taw for Protection of Wildlife and Habitat
The Following species are included in a proposed law in the Republic of ... Panama regarding the protection and conservation of wildlife and habitat. Those marked with an asterisk are already protected by U.S. Public law 93-205, which obliges any person under U.S. jurisdiction, or any adency, department or instrumentality of the U.S.Government to afford them and their habitat a certain amount of protection. Those marked with a """ occur on the pipeline road area.
